recentItems.title: Team NL at the Artistic Gymnastics World Championships Rotterdam 2026 🤸‍♂️🇳🇱 Netherlands
recentItems.description:
Team NL have shown up to podium practice at Rotterdam 2026 looking sharp and hungry for the medals. The Artistic Gymnastics World Championships take place from October 17th to 25th 2026, in Rotterdam Ahoy. Over nine days, the world’s best male and female gymnasts will compete for medals in team, all-around, and apparatus events!
